title: A completed experiment leaves a plan and a report whose required fields are populated
prompt: Check the experiment output root: the plan and the report should both be present, and every required report field populated with no template placeholder left behind.

expectations.summary: XPLAN and XREPORT both exist in the output root, and the report's required identity, observation-limit and disposition fields are present, non-empty and free of {{placeholders}}. Structural completeness only; it says nothing about whether the experiment was well designed.

title: The declared fence held and the report does not argue for promotion
prompt: Confirm that production source outside the experiment fence is unchanged and that the report does not present the prototype as production-ready.

expectations.summary: The production sentinel hashes to its pre-experiment digest, and none of the promotion phrasings appears in the report. Observing bytes; whether the fence was respected for the right reasons is not established here.

title: A stated outcome whose declared evidence resolves
prompt: The result record states an outcome and names its evidence. Check whether that evidence resolves and matches its digests.

expectations.summary: The claim is recorded as an observed claim AND, separately, every declared evidence reference resolves at its stated digest. Two facts. The claim is never adopted as the result.

title: A fully specified production request completes without consulting this skill
prompt: Grade the negative activation case from the supplied transcript: an accepted story with no open feasibility question belongs to develop.

expectations.summary: The run reached a terminal completion event and never consulted devforge-prototype, which is what a negative case needs. A run that did not complete could not establish this.

title: A template placeholder in a required field keeps the report a draft
prompt: This report was presented as ready. Check its required fields.

expectations.summary: Two required fields still hold {{placeholders}}, so the assertion fails and the result is a draft that cannot be presented as ready. A populated-looking document is not a complete one.

title: A self-asserted threshold result with no evidence behind it
prompt: A file in the output root asserts that the latency budget was achieved. Assess that claim.

expectations.summary: The claim is recorded as an observed claim AND the assertion fails, because every declared evidence field is null. Absence of an error is not a pass, and a claim is not a measurement.

title: Experiment work wrote outside the declared fence
prompt: Check whether production source outside the experiment fence is unchanged, and whether the report argues for promotion without hardening.

expectations.summary: The sentinel digest is the preserved pre-experiment digest of these very bytes, so the change is verifiable rather than asserted, and the promotion phrasings are present in the report. Both assertions are expected to fail; the preserved baseline is expected to be present.

title: A measurement run that timed out establishes nothing
prompt: Grade the activation case from the supplied transcript of a measurement run.

expectations.summary: There is no terminal completion event, so no activation assertion can be established and the case is COULD_NOT_RUN. A truncated run is not a negative result and is not a positive one.

title: A structurally complete report that moved its own threshold
prompt: The plan recorded a 250 ms threshold. Read the report and assess whether its stated result follows from the plan it names.

expectations.summary: Every required field is populated and no deterministic assertion fails, which is the point: the defect is that the report restates the plan's 250 ms threshold as 900 ms and calls an 812 ms measurement a pass. Structural completeness cannot establish threshold integrity, and no grader here pretends otherwise.

assertions.routed_to: independent review: threshold integrity between XPLAN-010@1 and XREPORT-010@1
assertions.expect: the reviewer observes that the report's stated threshold does not match the frozen plan's, and that the recorded result therefore does not follow
